youtube.title: Cheaper to Erase a Town Than Stop a Fire #Shorts
youtube.description:
The town of Centralia once had over a thousand people. Today only a handful are left. So why did nobody put the fire out? Crews dug, flooded the tunnels, and pumped in mud and ash, but the fire kept slipping away along the coal. Moving the people turned out to cost far less than fighting it, so house after house was bought and torn down. It was cheaper to erase a town than to put out a fire. Full episode on the channel.
